calendar_events_confirmed_by_check.name: calendar_events_confirmed_by_check
calendar_events_confirmed_by_check.value: "calendar_events"."status" <> 'confirmed' or ("calendar_events"."confirmed_by_user_id" is not null and "calendar_events"."confirmed_at" is not null)

flags_open_dedupe_key.name: flags_open_dedupe_key
flags_open_dedupe_key.where: "flags"."resolved_at" is null and "flags"."dedupe_key" is not null

flags_resolution_reason_check.name: flags_resolution_reason_check
flags_resolution_reason_check.value: "flags"."resolved_at" is null or ("flags"."resolution_reason" is not null and length("flags"."resolution_reason") > 0)

notification_outbox_recipient_consistenc.name: notification_outbox_recipient_consistency_check
notification_outbox_recipient_consistenc.value:
("notification_outbox"."recipient_type" = 'user' and "notification_outbox"."recipient_user_id" is not null and "notification_outbox"."recipient_party_id" is null)
      or ("notification_outbox"."recipient_type" = 'party' and "notification_outbox"."recipient_party_id" is not null and "notification_outbox"."recipient_user_id" is null)

tasks_owner_consistency_check.name: tasks_owner_consistency_check
tasks_owner_consistency_check.value:
("tasks"."owner_type" = 'user' and "tasks"."owner_user_id" is not null and "tasks"."owner_party_id" is null)
      or ("tasks"."owner_type" = 'client' and "tasks"."owner_party_id" is not null and "tasks"."owner_user_id" is null)
      or ("tasks"."owner_type" = 'firm' and "tasks"."owner_user_id" is null and "tasks"."owner_party_id" is null)
